database.description: The path of the database which is being opened.

update_schedule.description: Frequency of database updates: daily, weekly, monthly, or disabled.

quiet.description: Enable quiet mode to suppress output.

export_format.description: Output format for commands supporting it: list, ipset, nftables, xt_geoip.

address_family.description: Address family filter for export/queries: ipv4, ipv6, or all.

export_countries.description: List of ISO3166 Alpha-2 country codes to include in exports.

export_asns.description: List of Autonomous System numbers to include in exports.

export_flags.description: List of flags to filter networks: anonymous-proxy, satellite-provider, anycast, drop.

lookup_addresses.description: List of IP addresses to perform lookups on.
